# BOKKO

> BOKKO (BOKKO Marketing Specialists) is a revenue-focused marketing agency in Bangkok, Thailand, with its own in-house production team. One team handles creative direction, photography and film, social media management, creator and affiliate campaigns, performance advertising on Meta, Google and TikTok, e-commerce management, SEO and AI search optimisation, and website development, measured by revenue, bookings and enquiries. BOKKO is best known for hospitality (restaurants, hotels, bars and beach clubs) and also works with travel, fashion, beauty, real estate and retail brands.

BOKKO is the trading name of BOKKO Digital Co., Ltd. Contact: info@bokko.co, 098 862 2788

Official profiles: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/bokkomarketing · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/bokko_th/ · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/bokko-marketing · Google Business Profile https://www.google.com/maps?cid=17301855315386970568 · Clutch https://clutch.co/profile/bokko-digital-co · Sortlist https://www.sortlist.com/agency/bokko-digital

Office: 59/19 T59 Westgate, Rattanathibet Road, Bang Rak Phatthana, Bang Bua Thong, Nonthaburi 11110, Thailand. Open Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00. BOKKO works with clients across Thailand, including Bangkok, Khao Yai, Pattaya and Koh Samui. Content management and paid advertising management are also available to clients outside Thailand.

Founder: Jack Brown, Founder & Director of BOKKO, with 10 years of experience in Thailand’s hospitality and digital marketing industries across restaurants, luxury hotels, travel and lifestyle brands. He remains personally involved in the strategy, management and optimisation of BOKKO’s advertising campaigns across Meta, Google and TikTok, supported by an in-house team.

Services: hospitality marketing, social media management, content production, Meta, Google and TikTok advertising, influencer and KOL campaigns, e-commerce management (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop), SEO and AI search optimisation, and website development. Hospitality is the core specialism; BOKKO also works with brands in other industries. Clients outside hospitality: Thai Airways (travel), FUNDAO (fashion), The Residences at Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok (real estate), BNT (electronics and lighting), Moonshot Skincare (beauty, e-commerce), Bigen (hair colour: creators, KOLs, affiliates and advertising for new product launches), Little Farm (food, e-commerce), Italasia (wine: content and advertising supporting the customers who sell its products), Town Hall Sukhumvit 49 (retail and events), Chabatree (homeware) and Swing Society (golf and leisure).

E-commerce results: Moonshot Skincare, more than ฿300,000 in sales within 24 hours on a Double Day campaign and number one in Skincare on Shopee; Little Farm, sales up from fewer than 10 a week to more than 100 a day.

What sets BOKKO apart: an in-house production team (creative direction, photography, film and editing done by the people who plan the campaign); work measured in revenue, bookings and sales, not reach; and creative, social media, performance advertising, e-commerce, SEO and websites handled by one team. BOKKO is both a creative agency and a performance marketing agency.

Track record: 80+ marketing clients, more than 200 million THB in ad spend managed, a record 131x campaign ROAS, and 10 years of marketing experience.

Pricing: BOKKO Hospitality Growth, the restaurant base package, is ฿85,000 + VAT per month, based on a six-month partnership, and includes Meta, Google and TikTok advertising management with no ad management fee. One-off and shorter projects are also available. Signature Content Production is ฿85,000 + VAT for a one-off full-day photo and video shoot. E-Commerce Growth Management starts at ฿120,000 + VAT per month. Optional add-ons: website and landing page builds from ฿79,000 + VAT, and creator and KOL campaigns from ฿25,000 + creator fees + VAT.

Company: agreements and invoices are issued by BOKKO Digital Co., Ltd. (company registration number 0125566023907), registered in Thailand. The team has worked with clients since 2016 and has operated as BOKKO Digital Co., Ltd. since 2023. Website terms: https://bokko.co/terms · Privacy policy: https://bokko.co/privacy

Client feedback: testimonials are published in full, with the client's name and role, at https://bokko.co/testimonials/. Naiyabhak Charnvirakul, CEO of Rancho Charnvee Resort and Country Club: "More than just a friendly and helpful team, Bokko delivers real results." Ou Baholyodhin, CEO of Rongros Dining Group, on Contento and Lucky Duck Bar: "Their creativity is unparalleled, and the quality of their content is always exceptional." Shanasit Thirakomen, CEO of Shaloba Eatery: "Working with Jack has been a game-changer for our restaurant business."

## Guides

- [Agency or in-house: who should run your restaurant’s marketing?](https://bokko.co/guides/agency-or-in-house-restaurant-marketing/): Hire in-house when marketing is a full-time, daily job across several outlets and you can fund a small team. Use an agency when you need strategy, production and advertising skills working together from the first month. Many venues do best with both: an in-house coordinator who knows the business, and an agency that brings the specialist skills.
- [How to get more customers into a Bangkok restaurant on weekdays](https://bokko.co/guides/more-restaurant-customers-on-weekdays/): Pick one weekday occasion to win, such as office lunch, after-work drinks or early-week dinner. Give people a reason that only exists on those days, put it in front of people who are nearby at the time they decide, and measure weekday covers separately from weekends.
- [Marketing a new restaurant opening in Bangkok: what to do and when](https://bokko.co/guides/marketing-a-new-restaurant-opening-bangkok/): Start six to eight weeks before opening. Settle the positioning and shoot the content first, set up Google Maps and booking before any advertising, use creators and local campaigns in opening week, and then move from awareness to repeatable demand in months two and three.
- [How much does restaurant marketing cost in Bangkok?](https://bokko.co/guides/restaurant-marketing-cost-bangkok/): With BOKKO, a full restaurant marketing programme is ฿85,000 + VAT a month, based on a six-month partnership, plus any advertising budget you choose. A one-off professional shoot is ฿85,000 + VAT. Creator campaigns start from ฿25,000 plus creator fees. BOKKO does not charge an ad management fee.
- [How to tell whether a marketing agency is working towards revenue](https://bokko.co/guides/marketing-agency-revenue-or-vanity-metrics/): Ask what the objective for the first month is, what the monthly report will show, and for a named client result. An agency focused on commercial results will answer in bookings, enquiries and revenue, and will be clear about what cannot be measured directly.
- [Boutique agency or large performance firm: how a hotel should choose](https://bokko.co/guides/boutique-agency-or-large-firm-for-hotels/): Choose on the job, not the size. A large performance firm suits hotel groups that need search, metasearch and media buying across many properties and markets. A boutique agency suits a single property or outlet that needs content, social media and advertising planned together by a senior team.
- [Getting more from a Meta ads budget: six checks for restaurants and hotels](https://bokko.co/guides/getting-more-from-meta-ads-budget/): When Meta advertising spends without bringing bookings, the cause is usually one of six things: the campaign objective, missing conversion tracking, audience and location, the creative, the destination, or a lack of regular review. Check them in that order.
- [What to do instead of generic social media management](https://bokko.co/guides/alternatives-to-generic-social-media-management/): Replace the routine posting schedule with activity tied to an objective: content pillars built around what you sell, advertising aimed at bookings, Google Maps and Search for local demand, briefed creators, a professional content library, a separate identity for each outlet, and lead campaigns for events.

## ภาษาไทย

BOKKO (BOKKO Marketing Specialists) คือเอเจนซี่การตลาดและดิจิทัลเอเจนซี่ (Digital Agency) ในกรุงเทพฯ ที่มุ่งสร้างรายได้ และมีทีมโปรดักชันภายในของตัวเอง เป็นบริษัทการตลาดออนไลน์ครบวงจรที่ทีมเดียวดูแลครีเอทีฟ ถ่ายภาพและวิดีโอ รับดูแลเพจและโซเชียลมีเดีย แคมเปญครีเอเตอร์ อินฟลูเอนเซอร์และ Affiliate รับยิงแอด Facebook, Instagram, Google และ TikTok รับดูแลร้านค้า Shopee, Lazada และ TikTok Shop รับทำ SEO และ AI Search และรับทำเว็บไซต์ ให้บริการทั่วประเทศไทย

ลูกค้า: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok, Thai Airways, Opera Italian Restaurant, Pi Samui Beach Club, FUNDAO, The Residences at Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok, BNT, Moonshot Skincare, Bigen, Little Farm, Italasia

ผลลัพธ์ที่เผยแพร่: ROAS สูงสุด 131x และยอดขายกว่า 6 ล้านบาทภายใน 72 ชั่วโมงสำหรับ Mandarin Oriental Bangkok, ROAS สูงสุด 114x และยอดขายกว่า 50 ล้านบาทภายใน 4 เดือนสำหรับ Thai Airways, บริหารงบโฆษณามาแล้วกว่า 200 ล้านบาท, ลูกค้ากว่า 80 ราย

ราคา: แพ็กเกจหลักรายเดือน 85,000 บาท + VAT (อิงจากความร่วมมือระยะ 6 เดือน รับงานครั้งเดียวและโปรเจกต์ระยะสั้นด้วย), โปรดักชันคอนเทนต์เต็มวัน 85,000 บาท + VAT, SEO และ AI Search เริ่มต้น 30,000 บาท + VAT ต่อเดือน, บริหารอีคอมเมิร์ซเริ่มต้น 120,000 บาท + VAT ต่อเดือน, เว็บไซต์เริ่มต้น 79,000 บาท + VAT
